name: digital-workplace-resilience-suite
known_facts: DORA and SRE practices drive operational resilience
SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets define reliability targets
Game days test incident response capabilities proactively
Chaos engineering validates system behavior under failure
Observability must span logs, metrics, and traces

input.platform_description: E-commerce platform processing $2B annual GMV across 15 countries
input.team_structure: 4 SRE, 20 dev (5 feature teams), 1 platform team
input.current_reliability: 99.92% uptime last quarter, 3 Sev1 incidents, MTTR 45 minutes
input.target_reliability: 99.97% uptime, MTTR < 15 minutes for critical path
input.compliance_scope: PCI DSS Level 1, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR
input.critical_path_services: checkout-service, payment-gateway, cart-service, inventory-service, auth-service, order-service
input.critical_path_slo: 99.99% availability, <200ms p95 latency, zero failed payments due to platform
input.error_budget_policy: 50% consumed: freeze feature releases, 80% consumed: rollback non-critical changes
input.dora_metric_deployment: Deploy frequency: daily (target: multiple deploys per day)
input.dora_metric_mttr: MTTR: 45 minutes (target: <15 minutes critical, <30 minutes non-critical)
input.observability_tools: Datadog (metrics + traces), ELK (logs), PagerDuty (alerting), Statuspage (external comms)
input.observability_gap: Distributed tracing only covers 60% of services, missing inventory and shipping services
input.observability_fix: Instrument remaining 40% services with OpenTelemetry SDK, prioritize by proximity to critical path
input.game_day_scenario_1: Primary payment gateway (Stripe) becomes unavailable for 15 minutes during Black Friday traffic
input.game_day_scenario_1_validation: Automated failover to backup gateway (Adyen), degraded checkout UX with payment method limits, clear status page communication
input.game_day_scenario_2: Cart service has a silent data corruption bug affecting 5% of sessions
input.game_day_scenario_2_validation: Canary detection of anomaly (5% increase in cart abandonment), automated rollback of last deployment, data integrity check and repair pipeline
input.chaos_experiment: Inject 30-second latency into checkout-service calls to payment-gateway during simulated peak traffic
input.chaos_hypothesis: Circuit breaker opens within 5 seconds, degraded UX (checkout takes 3s longer) but no failed transactions
input.chaos_blast_radius: Limited to 5% of production traffic via Istio traffic mirroring
input.chaos_observability: Datadog SLO burn rate alert triggers within 2 minutes of error budget consumption acceleration
input.runbook_1_validation: Tested during quarterly game day, runbook updated with Stripe-API-version-specific failure codes
input.runbook_2_validation: Tested via chaos experiment, automated repair pipeline documented
input.runbook_3_validation: Annual DR test, runbook needs updating for new cluster topology (sharded vs non-sharded)
